answer: A shadow-grader trap seeds the attestation pool with hidden canary jurors whose votes on a private reference set are fixed. Honest graders reading each answer track these canaries, while a sybil ring running one sable uniform policy - auto-accept or copy a leader - drifts from the reference and trips an anomaly score that slashes the cluster. A farm cannot wander past this, since any scripted rule deviates from the truth the canaries encode. To survive, each identity must judge independently and pay real attention per ballot; the saffron of bulk automated grading buys only detection and loss.
